proposal.reactor_type: 5 mL SS packed-bed reactor, conditionally packed with Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 from the batch protocol
proposal.residence_time_basis: Nominal liquid-feed residence time based on the stated 5.0 mL geometric reactor volume divided by the 0.100 mL/min liquid flow. It is not the true catalyst-bed void-volume residence time; that requires measured packed-bed void volume.

contents: N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol; no acetic acid in this conservative initial condition

proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: Deliver the premixed methanolic substrate solution to the liquid inlet and meter H2 separately to the certified gas-liquid mixer immediately upstream of the bed. This prevents sending H2 through the liquid pump and minimizes upstream two-phase volume. The 2.0 sccm H2 setpoint is 8.92 molar equivalents relative to substrate under the stated liquid-feed condition, while remaining far below the 100 sccm MFC maximum.
pre_reactor_steps: BLOCKED: do not charge or operate until a hydrogen-compatible means of maintaining and verifying 60 C is available.

BLOCKED: do not charge or operate until a defined Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 catalyst inventory is available and its Pd loading, particle size, packing method, retained-bed volume, and pressure drop are documented.
Conditional future setup: pack the 5 mL reactor with the documented Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 catalyst bed, retain particles with suitable end frits, and record the actual bed void volume.

Conditional future setup: flush the assembled liquid path with methanol at low flow, establish the 10 bar BPR setpoint, and perform the site's approved hydrogen-service leak check before admitting H2.
Conditional future setup: begin liquid flow before H2, then introduce H2 at 2.0 sccm only after stable liquid flow and pressure are established.
post_reactor_steps: Route the reactor outlet through the 10 bar BPR; no unlisted gas-liquid separator is assumed.

The BPR discharge must be routed only to an approved controlled hydrogen vent/exhaust and suitable collection arrangement; neither is identified in the authoritative inventory, so operation remains blocked.

For a future authorized screen, collect timed depressurized fractions only after steady state, then assay for N-diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol consumption and 3-azetidinol formation. Do not infer conversion from gas uptake alone.
proposal.chemistry_notes: The sole chemistry precedent supplied is batch hydrogenolysis of N-diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol in methanol over Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 at 60 C for 5 h, giving 3-azetidinol in 38.1% yield. It does not establish packed-bed catalyst life, pressure-drop behavior, selectivity, or required residence time. Acetic acid is omitted from this first conditional target because it is optional in the source protocol and can form an azetidinol salt; if conversion is inadequate after a catalyst-qualified baseline, a separately controlled acid-additive screen may be considered. Nominal substrate throughput is 0.0100 mmol/min. H2 flow is 0.0892 mmol/min at STP, giving 8.92 equivalents relative to substrate.

stage_parameters.stage: Conditional target operating point; not authorized to execute

reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: 0.100 mL/min is within the HPLC pump range of 0.01-5.0 mL/min and provides a 50.0 min nominal geometric-volume liquid residence time in a 5.0 mL reactor.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: 60 C matches the source batch protocol, but no listed hardware can heat or control the reactor at this temperature; this is a conditional target only.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.100 M is a conservative assumed starting concentration. The batch protocol does not provide concentration, so it must be experimentally qualified rather than treated as established.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: 10 bar is the lowest listed BPR option and is within the required 10-20 bar range. A 10 bar(g) setpoint is assumed for the gas-volume calculation.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: The inventory specifies a 5.0 mL packed-bed reactor. Actual fluid hold-up will be lower than geometric volume after catalyst packing and must be measured.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_in_channel_min: 15.4 min is a nominal geometric-volume calculation using liquid flow plus ideal-gas pressure-corrected H2 flow: 5.0 mL divided by (0.100 + 0.224) mL/min. It is not a validated gas-liquid or catalyst-contact residence time because H2 dissolves and is consumed.
reasoning_per_field.gas_flow_actual_mL_min: At 2.0 sccm referenced to 0 C and 1.01325 bar, 60 C, and assumed 10 bar(g) = 11.013 bar absolute, ideal-gas H2 volumetric flow is 2.0 x (333.15/273.15) x (1.01325/11.013) = 0.224 mL/min.
reasoning_per_field.light_setup: No light source is required or available.
reasoning_per_field.catalyst: Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 is identified only in the raw batch protocol, not in the authoritative inventory. Its absence, and the absence of bed specifications, is a blocking gap.

literature_analogies: The provided batch protocol is the only supplied analogy: Pd(OH)2/Al2O3-mediated hydrogenolysis in methanol at 60 C for 5 h, optionally accelerated by acetic acid, with 38.1% isolated product yield.
No direct continuous packed-bed literature analogue, catalyst loading, particle specification, or flow stability data were supplied; none is assumed.
safety_flags: BLOCK: no listed heater or temperature-control hardware can establish or verify 60 C.
BLOCK: no listed Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 catalyst inventory or packed-bed specification is available.

Hydrogen operation requires the certified H2 MFC and certified gas-liquid mixer, 10 bar BPR control, hydrogen-service leak verification, and routing of BPR discharge to an approved hydrogen-safe exhaust.
Do not exceed the 50 bar ratings stated for the HPLC pump, mixer, H2 MFC, or SS tubing; the selected 10 bar BPR target is below these stated limits.

Two-phase flow through a packed bed can cause pressure fluctuations, channeling, and uncertain residence time; monitor pressure behavior during any future authorized commissioning and stop on unstable pressure or evidence of blockage.
No downstream separator or collection/vent hardware is listed; do not improvise depressurization or vent H2 into an uncontrolled area.
proposal.confidence: High confidence that the listed inventory is insufficient for safe execution at 60 C; low confidence in reaction performance at the conditional numeric point because packed-bed catalyst properties and flow behavior are unspecified.
